title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on the Issue of How to Handle Cases Where a People's Court Finds That an Application for Enforcement of an Arbitral Award or a Lawsuit Against an Arbitral Award Already Accepted Is Not Within Its Jurisdiction

articles.content_en:
Reply on How to Handle the Problem of a People's Court Discovering that a Case for Enforcement of an Arbitration Award or a Case Filed Against an Arbitration Award Has Been Accepted But Does Not Fall Under Its Jurisdiction
Fa (Yan) Fu [1988] No. 8
Higher People's Court of Hebei Province:
Your request for instruction, Document No. (87) Ji Fa (Jing) Qing Zi No. 3, has been received. Upon study, the reply is as follows:

When a People's Court accepts a case concerning a party's application for enforcement of an effective award by an arbitration body or a party's prosecution against an arbitration award, the court shall conduct a careful examination. If, after accepting the case, it is discovered that the case does not fall under the jurisdiction of the court, the court shall promptly transfer the case to the People's Court that has jurisdiction over the case in accordance with the provisions of Article 32 of the Civil Procedure Law (for Trial Implementation), and shall simultaneously notify all parties concerned. Where a party's application for enforcement or prosecution has not exceeded the statutory time limit, the People's Court that has jurisdiction shall not refuse to accept the transferred case on the ground that the time limit has already expired at the time of transfer.

Reply hereby.
January 13, 1988
